figurative_meaning_en: Contract laborer or daily wage worker
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে গ্রামে জনমজুর হিসেবে কাজ করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He works as a day laborer in the village.
The day laborers work on the construction site for daily wages.
note: This term is commonly used in Bengali to refer to casual or contract-based manual laborers, reflecting socio-economic realities in rural and semi-urban areas.
